description: G8 gating: only book tools are offered and the reader asks both what Alice does and relates it to their own situation. A book mapping must not address the reader (validator-enforced for every book mapping); the application stays unmapped in Muse's voice.

input.reader_message: In chapter one, what does Alice do when every door in the hall is locked? I keep feeling stuck like that at work, so I'd like to know how she handles it.

librarian_evidence: There were doors all round the hall, but they were all locked; and when Alice had been all the way down one side and up the other, trying every door, she walked sadly down the middle, wondering how she was ever to get out again.

criteria: reports only what the passage says Alice does
keeps any application to the reader's work separate and tentative, in its own voice
adds no detail the passage does not state
forbidden_claims: advice about the reader's job presented as what the book says
